blocks.sig: say what would you say? then tap “show the answer”.
text remember anna? present perfect or past simple? say the missing words. then tap the yellow to check.
game snakes and ladders: take turns to roll the dice and move. do the task on your square, then tap to check.
model here's an example. complete the conversation. then tap the yellow to check.
mix make questions from the table and ask your partner.
questions round 2: your real news. then swap roles.

cards.sig: i've been really busy since september. add the time i've been really busy. + since september no change: since september — до сих пор.
we finally managed to get away for a couple of weeks in august. add the time we've finally managed to get away for a couple of weeks. + in august the tense changes: in august — законченное время.
work has been crazy this autumn. add the time work has been crazy. + this autumn no change: осень ещё не закончилась.
i haven't had a day off for ages. add the time i haven't had a day off. + for ages no change: for ages — «сто лет», до сих пор.
we had a lovely change of scenery over the summer. add the time we've had a lovely change of scenery. + over the summer the tense changes: over the summer — лето закончилось.
i started a new course a week ago. add the time i've started a new course. + a week ago the tense changes: ago → past simple.
i caught up with some old friends last weekend. add the time i've caught up with some old friends. + last weekend the tense changes: last weekend — законченное время.
i went to a lovely café with anna two days ago. add the time i've been to a lovely café with anna. + two days ago the tense changes: ago — всегда past simple.
did you manage to get away this summer? add the time have you managed to get away? + this summer [it's november now.] the tense changes: лето закончилось → и вопрос в past simple.
when did you start your new job? our sentence: say it right when have you started your new job? when? — конкретный момент → past simple.

i went to the museum a week ago. our sentence: say it right i 've been to the museum a week ago. a week ago — законченное время → past simple. сравни: i've been to a great exhibition! (новость, без времени).
i gave up after episode three. our sentence: say it right i 've given up after episode three. after episode three — законченный момент → past simple.

questions.5.sig: 1 tell your partner two pieces of news from the last few weeks (present perfect: i've…).
2 your partner asks two questions about each piece of news in the past simple, e.g. when…? who with? how was it?
3 then ask your partner one question from the table that you haven't asked yet.
